writing.sample_en:
【参考范文 · 161 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility. As society changes at an unprecedented pace, young people often face distractions and pressures that weaken their commitment to family, community, and the future. Without a strong sense of responsibility, they may become self-centered and short-sighted.
The decline of responsibility among youth is partly caused by the instant gratification culture brought by technology and social media. Many young people are used to receiving immediate rewards and may avoid duties that require long-term effort. To address this problem, schools and families should work together to cultivate accountability through real tasks and role models. For example, involving students in community service can help them understand the value of contributing to society.
In conclusion, enhancing young people's sense of responsibility is not only a personal virtue but also a social necessity. Only when the younger generation takes responsibility seriously can society achieve sustainable development and harmony.

lines.en: W: Hi, Frank, are you working through your lunch hour again?

lines.en: M: No, not at all. It's my 10th wedding anniversary next week, and I promised Jane that I would book a city break for us, as I have annual leave to take, and it would be nice to celebrate somewhere warm. So, I'm trying to book something in Barcelona.
lines.zh: M: 不，完全不是。我和简下周要过结婚十周年纪念日了，我答应过她要为我们预订一次城市短途旅行，因为我还有年假要休，而且能找个温暖的地方庆祝一下也不错。所以，我正在设法预订去巴塞罗那的行程。

lines.en: W: That sounds so romantic. I adore Barcelona. It's such a fabulous cosmopolitan city. There's so much to do there, excellent food, and that cathedral that they are still building after about 150 years. Very cool.
lines.zh: W: 听起来真浪漫。我非常喜欢巴塞罗那。那是一座非常棒的国际化城市。那里有很多事情可做，美食也很棒，还有那座已经修建了大约150年、至今仍在建造的教堂。太酷了。

lines.en: M: I know. But the anniversary is looming, and I'm still scrambling to find accommodation. Everything is either wildly expensive or already fully booked. I'm starting to feel a bit frantic.
lines.zh: M: 我知道。但纪念日就要到了，我还在手忙脚乱地找住宿。要么贵得离谱，要么已经全部订满。我开始有点慌了。

lines.en: W: Well, if you are going for a whole week, why don't you do a couple of nights in somewhere really glamorous, and then do the rest of the week a bit further up the coast, where the accommodation is cheaper, and that will offset the cost of the expensive place?
lines.zh: W: 这样吧，如果你们要去整整一周，为什么不先在一个非常豪华的地方住几个晚上，然后把剩下的时间安排在海岸线再往北一点的地方，那里住宿更便宜，这样就能抵消住昂贵地方的费用了？

lines.en: M: That might be a good plan. It's not too expensive to rent a car, so we could still drive into the city. Yes, there are lots of places outside the city that have pools and are all inclusive, so we wouldn't even need to pay for food or drinks. I'll send a query now about the dates we're interested in.
lines.zh: M: 这或许是个不错的计划。租车也不算太贵，所以我们还是可以开车进城。对了，城外有很多地方带游泳池，而且提供全包服务，这样我们连吃饭和饮料的钱都不用另外付了。我现在就发个咨询，问问我们感兴趣的日期是否有空。

lines.en: W: That sounds perfect. I'm sure that Jane will be absolutely thrilled to bits. I really do recommend visiting that cathedral. You can go all the way up to the top of it, but you need to go up a really steep spiral staircase to get there.
lines.zh: W: 听起来太完美了。我相信简一定会高兴坏的。我真的很推荐去参观那座教堂。你们可以一直登到顶部，但要到那里必须爬一段非常陡的螺旋楼梯。

lines.en: M: Considering Jane is terrified of heights, I think if I tried to make her do that, I would come back divorced. Thanks for the help though; it was turning into a logistical nightmare.
lines.zh: M: 考虑到简恐高，我要是想让她去爬那个，我回来时可能就已经离婚了。不过还是谢谢你的帮助；这件事本来都快变成一场后勤噩梦了。

lines.en: W: Hey there, Paul. How's it going?
lines.zh: W: 嗨，保罗。最近怎么样？

lines.en: M: Hi, Suzanne. Just keeping busy with the usual stuff, filling prescriptions, talking to patients about their medications, that kind of thing. How about you?
lines.zh: M: 嗨，苏珊。就是忙着做平常的事，开处方药、和患者聊聊他们的用药情况之类的。你呢？

lines.en: W: Same here, although I did have an interesting case come in this morning. A patient came in, inquiring about a medication that had a potential interaction with another medication she was already taking.
lines.zh: W: 我也一样，不过今天早上来了一个挺有意思的病例。一位患者来咨询一种药，而这种药可能会和她已经在服用的另一种药产生相互作用。

lines.en: M: Oh, that's always tricky. What did you do?
lines.zh: M: 哦，这种情况总是很棘手。你怎么处理的？

lines.en: W: I explained the issue to her as best I could, and recommended she double-check with her doctor. And you know what? She actually followed my advice, and the doctor ended up switching the patient's medication.
lines.zh: W: 我尽可能向她解释了这个问题，并建议她再向医生确认一下。你猜怎么着？她真的听从了我的建议，最后医生给这位患者换了药。

lines.en: M: Ah, that's great. You must feel quite accomplished.
lines.zh: M: 啊，那太好了。你一定很有成就感。

lines.en: W: Totally. These moments are the highlights of my routine work, employing my pharmaceutical expertise to the benefit of people's health and well-being.
lines.zh: W: 完全是。这些时刻是我日常工作中最精彩的部分，运用我的药学专业知识来促进人们的健康和福祉。

lines.en: M: I fully agree. Unfortunately, the opposite is true when the patient is too stubborn and they refuse to listen to us.
lines.zh: M: 我完全同意。遗憾的是，当患者太固执、不肯听我们的话时，情况就正好相反。

lines.en: W: So true. In other developments, we've had a lot of people coming in to get their flu shots, which is always good to see.
lines.zh: W: 确实如此。另外，最近有很多人来接种流感疫苗，这总是件令人高兴的事。

lines.en: M: Good, good. I've been working on a new medication therapy management program for our patients with chronic conditions. It helps patients manage their medications more effectively.
lines.zh: M: 很好，很好。我一直在为患有慢性疾病的患者制定一个新的药物治疗管理项目，帮助患者更有效地管理他们的用药。

lines.en: W: That sounds interesting.
lines.zh: W: 听起来很有意思。

lines.en: M: We review all of their medications, and make sure that they're taking them as prescribed. We also look for any potential drug interactions or side effects. Patient response has so far been very positive. Some have reported seeing improvements in their health, which is really rewarding to see.
lines.zh: M: 我们会检查他们所有的药物，确保他们按照处方服用。我们还会查找任何潜在的药物相互作用或副作用。到目前为止，患者的反响非常积极。有些人说自己的健康状况有所改善，看到这一点真的很令人欣慰。

lines.en: W: That's great to hear. Do you use text message reminders?
lines.zh: W: 听到这个真好。你们会使用短信提醒吗？

lines.en: M: Yes, absolutely.
lines.zh: M: 是的，当然会。

lines.en: W: It's a great idea. Medication non-adherence is a big problem, especially for older patients.
lines.zh: W: 这是个很好的主意。用药依从性差是个大问题，尤其是对老年患者来说。

lines.en: M: We're still in the early stages of the program, but I'm hopeful that it will make a real difference for our patients.
lines.zh: M: 这个项目还处于早期阶段，但我希望它能真正改善我们患者的情况。

lines.en: In America, at least, passion is a word that often comes up on job descriptions and in interviews. On the whole, passionate people are thought of in a positive light and considered likely to achieve their goals. But when it comes to predicting achievement, has the importance of passion been overstated?
lines.zh: 至少在美国，求职描述和面试中经常会提到“热情”一词。总的来说，人们对有热情的人持正面看法，认为他们很可能实现自己的目标。但说到预测成就时，热情的重要性是否被夸大了？

lines.en: According to a new study from Stanford University, passion may be less important in certain cultures, and the fact that passion is often seen as a key to achievement may reflect a distinctly Western model of motivation. The chief factor explored in the study was how individualistic a society was. In individualistic cultures, the researchers assert, people are more motivated by pursuing paths related to their passions, but those in collectivistic cultures are more likely to see themselves as part of a network. They often place fulfilling obligations to others above focusing on their own interests.
lines.zh: 根据斯坦福大学的一项新研究，热情在某些文化中的重要性可能较低，而热情常被视为成就关键这一事实，或许反映了一种明显具有西方特色的动机模式。研究考察的主要因素是一个社会的个人主义程度。研究人员断言，在个人主义文化中，人们更容易受到追求与自身热情相关道路的激励；而集体主义文化中的人则更可能将自己视为某个社会网络的一部分。他们往往更重视履行对他人的义务，而不是专注于自身的兴趣。

lines.en: The researchers looked at data from nearly 60 countries. They found that in science subjects, passion was positively correlated with academic achievements. Higher levels of enjoyment and interest also bolstered test scores.
lines.zh: 研究人员考察了来自近60个国家的数据。他们发现，在科学类学科中，热情与学业成就呈正相关。更高程度的愉悦感和兴趣也会提高测试成绩。

lines.en: But the strength of this correlation wasn't the same across cultures. Those in individualistic societies such as the U.S., Australia, and the UK showed a stronger link between passion and achievement. The effect of passion on performance was more subtle for those in more collectivistic societies such as Colombia or Thailand.
lines.zh: 但这种相关性的强度在不同文化之间并不相同。在美国、澳大利亚和英国等个人主义社会中，热情与成就之间的联系更为紧密。而对于哥伦比亚或泰国等更加集体主义的社会而言，热情对表现的影响则更为微妙。

lines.en: These findings were mirrored in achievement in both mathematics and reading. It's clear from the findings that passion isn't the only thing that motivates people to achieve their goals.
lines.zh: 数学和阅读方面的成就也呈现出同样的情况。从这些研究结果可以清楚看出，热情并不是激励人们实现目标的唯一因素。

lines.en: Why does nature create patterns? The reason patterns often appear in nature is simple: the same basic physical or chemical processes occur in many pattern substances and organisms as they form. Whether in plants and animals or rocks, foams and ice crystals, the intricate patterns that happen in nature come down to what's happening at the level of atoms and molecules.
lines.zh: 为什么自然界会形成各种图案？图案之所以经常出现在自然界中，原因很简单：在许多形成图案的物质和生物中，相同的基本物理或化学过程会反复发生。无论是在植物和动物中，还是在岩石、泡沫和冰晶中，自然界中出现的复杂图案，归根结底都与原子和分子层面发生的事情有关。

lines.en: A pattern in nature is any regularly repeated arrangement of shapes or colors. Some of the most striking examples include the six-sided arrays of rocks at Giant's Causeway in the United Kingdom, and the colorful stripes and spots on tropical fish. Patterns like these begin to form at a small scale when materials undergo processes like drying, freezing, wrinkling, diffusing and reacting. Those changes then give rise to complex patterns at a larger scale that people can see.
lines.zh: 自然界中的图案，是指形状或颜色有规律地重复排列的任何形式。其中一些最引人注目的例子包括英国巨人之路上六边形的岩石阵列，以及热带鱼身上色彩斑斓的条纹和斑点。这类图案在材料经历干燥、冻结、起皱、扩散和反应等过程时，会先在微小尺度上开始形成。随后，这些变化会在更大尺度上产生人们能够看见的复杂图案。

lines.en: Imagine delicate frozen crystals on a window during winter. What creates that pattern? When water freezes, its molecules begin clustering together. Water molecules have a particular bent shape that causes them to stack into clusters as they freeze. As the cluster grows, many outside factors, including humidity and temperature, begin to affect its overall shape. If the water is freezing on a window, for example, random imperfections on the glass surface affect the stacking and create the larger pattern.
lines.zh: 想象一下冬天窗户上精致的冰晶。是什么形成了这种图案？水结冰时，其中的分子开始聚集在一起。水分子具有特殊的弯曲形状，这使它们在冻结时会堆叠成团。随着团簇不断增大，包括湿度和温度在内的许多外部因素开始影响它的整体形状。例如，如果水是在窗户上结冰，玻璃表面的随机瑕疵就会影响分子的堆叠，并形成更大的图案。

lines.en: But scientists do not always know the purpose of a pattern, or even if there is one. The molecular processes involved are simple enough that they might generate a pattern by coincidence.
lines.zh: 但科学家并不总是知道某种图案的作用，甚至不知道它是否具有作用。相关的分子过程足够简单，因此它们可能只是偶然形成了某种图案。

lines.en: Many people, myself included, have multiple areas of life they would like to improve. For example, I would like to reach more people with my writing, to lift heavier weights at the gym, and to start practising mindfulness more consistently. Those are just a few of the goals I find desirable, and you probably have a long list yourself. The problem is, even if we are committed to working hard on our goals, our natural tendency is to return to our old habits at some point. Making a permanent lifestyle change is really difficult.
lines.zh: 包括我在内，许多人都希望改善生活中的多个方面。例如，我希望通过写作让更多人读到我的作品，希望在健身房举起更重的重量，也希望开始更加持续地练习正念。这些只是我认为值得追求的几个目标，而你自己可能也列有一长串目标。问题在于，即使我们决心为目标努力奋斗，我们的自然倾向仍然是在某个时候回到旧有习惯。要永久改变生活方式确实非常困难。

lines.en: Recently I've come across a few studies that will make these difficult lifestyle changes a bit easier. As you'll see, however, the approach to mastering many areas of life is somewhat counterintuitive. Research has shown that you are two to three times more likely to stick with your habits if you make a specific plan for when, where, and how you will perform the behavior. For example, in one study, scientists asked people to fill out a sentence to specify during the next week they would do at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise on which day, at what time of day, and at or in what place. Researchers found that people who filled out this sentence were two to three times more likely to actually exercise compared to a control group who did not make plans for their future behavior. Psychologists call these specific plans implementation intentions because they state when, where, and how you intend to implement a particular behavior.
lines.zh: 最近，我接触到了一些研究，这些研究将使这些艰难的生活方式改变变得稍微容易一些。不过，正如你将看到的，掌握生活中许多方面的方法有些违背直觉。研究表明，如果你针对自己将在何时、何地以及如何实施某种行为制订具体计划，那么坚持这些习惯的可能性会提高到原来的两到三倍。例如，在一项研究中，科学家要求人们填写一个句子，具体说明自己将在下一周的哪一天、一天中的什么时间，以及在什么地点进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。研究人员发现，与没有为未来行为制订计划的对照组相比，填写了这个句子的人实际进行锻炼的可能性高出两到三倍。心理学家将这些具体计划称为“执行意图”，因为它们说明了你打算在何时、何地以及如何实施某种特定行为。

lines.en: However, follow-up research has discovered implementation intentions only work when you focus on one thing at a time. In fact, researchers found that people who tried to accomplish multiple goals were less committed and less likely to succeed than those who focused on a single goal.
lines.zh: 然而，后续研究发现，执行意图只有在你一次专注于一件事时才会奏效。事实上，研究人员发现，试图实现多个目标的人，比专注于单一目标的人投入程度更低，成功的可能性也更小。

lines.en: Another science-based reason to focus on one thing at a time is that when you begin practising a new habit, it requires a lot of conscious effort to remember to do it. After a while, however, the pattern of behavior becomes easier. Eventually, your new habit becomes a normal routine, and the process is more or less mindless and automatic. The most important thing to note is that there is some tipping point at which new habits become more or less automatic. The time it takes to build a habit depends on many factors, including how difficult the habit is, your genetics, and more.
lines.zh: 一次专注于一件事还有一个基于科学的理由，那就是当你开始练习一种新习惯时，记得去做这件事需要付出大量有意识的努力。然而，过一段时间之后，这种行为模式会变得更加容易。最终，你的新习惯会成为一种日常惯例，而这一过程或多或少会变得无需意识参与，并且自动进行。需要注意的最重要一点是，存在这样一个临界点：在此之后，新习惯会或多或少地变得自动化。养成一个习惯所需的时间取决于许多因素，包括习惯的难度、你的遗传因素，以及其他因素。

lines.en: It was a lazy, hazy, crazy day on the dwarf planet Pluto when New Horizons, a spacecraft from Earth, flew by at a speed of 31,000 mph (miles per hour) two years ago. The spacecraft took a bunch of photos, made some quick measurements of Pluto's atmosphere, and sent them all back here, giving planetary scientists their first up-close look of the distant dwarf planet.
lines.zh: 两年前，在新视野号这艘来自地球的航天器以每小时31,000英里（英里/小时）的速度飞掠而过时，矮行星冥王星度过了慵懒、朦胧而疯狂的一天。这艘航天器拍摄了大量照片，对冥王星的大气层进行了一些快速测量，并将这些数据全部传回地球，使行星科学家们首次近距离观察到这颗遥远的矮行星。

lines.en: One of the more bizarre things they found was that the haze in Pluto's atmosphere was much thicker than previously thought. The planet also had an atmosphere much cooler than earlier estimates, topping out at −333.4°F.
lines.zh: 他们发现的较为奇异的现象之一，是冥王星大气层中的霾比先前认为的厚得多。这颗行星的大气层也比早先估计的冷得多，最高温度仅为−333.4°F。

lines.en: Now, a study published in Nature links those two atmospheric observations. A computer model developed by planetary scientist Xi Zhang and colleagues shows the haze of tiny droplets in the upper atmosphere is likely scattering light from the Sun, preventing heat from reaching the planet below. We see hazy skies on Earth too, from time to time, whenever solid particles get suspended in the air—from water-based fogs, to ash from fires, to the toxic droplets that make up a thick smog. But on Earth, the overall temperature of the planet is dominated by the distribution of gases in our atmosphere.
lines.zh: 如今，《自然》杂志发表的一项研究将这两项大气观测结果联系了起来。行星科学家张希及其同事开发的一种计算机模型显示，高层大气中由微小液滴形成的霾很可能会散射来自太阳的光，阻止热量抵达下方的行星。地球上也会不时出现雾霾天气，每当固体颗粒悬浮在空气中时，就可能形成这种现象，从含水雾气到火灾产生的灰烬，再到构成浓重烟雾的有毒液滴，都是如此。但在地球上，行星的整体温度主要由大气层中气体的分布决定。

lines.en: On Pluto, the authors suggest, haze might be more influential. Particles can reflect light from the Sun here on Earth: It happens after volcanoes erupt, emitting clouds of particles that reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere. Some people even propose imitating this phenomenon to alleviate the effects of climate change. But our planet isn't dominated by that process, or at least it hasn't been for a few billion years.
lines.zh: 作者认为，在冥王星上，霾的影响可能更大。在地球上，颗粒物能够反射来自太阳的光：火山喷发后会释放出由颗粒物组成的云团，将太阳光线反射回大气层。有些人甚至提出模仿这一现象，以减轻气候变化的影响。但我们的行星并不是由这一过程主导的，至少在过去几十亿年里不是如此。

lines.en: If Pluto's atmosphere is very different from ours and from that of other nearby planets, it could help scientists expand their understanding of planetary atmospheres. But right now, this is just a good guess based on data from New Horizons and a sophisticated computer model, not direct observations of the haze's composition.
lines.zh: 如果冥王星的大气层与地球以及其他邻近行星的大气层截然不同，这将有助于科学家拓展对行星大气层的认识。但目前，这只是基于新视野号获得的数据和一个复杂计算机模型提出的合理推测，而不是对霾的成分进行直接观测所得出的结论。

lines.en: There are other theories floating around to explain Pluto's cool temperatures, including blaming the cold air on gases in the atmosphere.
lines.zh: 关于解释冥王星低温的理论还有其他一些，包括把寒冷的空气归因于大气层中的气体。

lines.en: Luckily, the authors will get a chance to test their notions when the James Webb Space Telescope launches later. That observatory can detect different spectrums of light, which the hazy Plutonian atmosphere would be positively glowing with as it scattered sunlight. The researchers just have to wait and see if the light from the telescope validates their bright idea.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜稍后发射后，作者们将有机会检验他们的观点。这座天文台能够探测不同光谱的光，而冥王星朦胧的大气层在散射阳光时很可能会发出大量这样的光。研究人员只需等待并观察望远镜接收到的光是否会验证他们的这个妙想。

lines.en: Parents have a small window where they can influence their 8- to 10-year-old children's music taste, researchers have concluded. The 24-month time frame comes at an age when youngsters are old enough to appreciate poetic lyrics and snappy tunes, but have not yet started to be embarrassed by their mother and father's preferences. Dr. Hauke Egermann, a lecturer in music at the University of York, carried out a literature review into more than a dozen studies looking at parental musical influence. "Children have an openness to new music, and this means parents have an important role to play in developing the musical preferences of their kids," he said.
lines.zh: 研究人员得出结论，父母有一个短暂的窗口期，可以影响8至10岁孩子的音乐品味。这段24个月的时期处于这样一个年龄阶段：孩子已经足够大，能够欣赏富有诗意的歌词和朗朗上口的曲调，但还没有开始因父母的音乐偏好而感到尴尬。约克大学音乐讲师豪克·埃格尔曼博士对十多项有关父母音乐影响的研究进行了文献综述。他说：“孩子对新音乐持开放态度，这意味着父母在培养孩子的音乐偏好方面扮演着重要角色。”

lines.en: However, time is of the essence as parental influence is most likely to be effective during the critical time period before age ten. During adolescence, children tend to gravitate away from their parents' choices and are more influenced by their peers. A separate survey of 2,000 British parents by music streaming service Deezer also found that nearly four-fifths of parents agreed that their children were far more receptive to their musical suggestions before the age of ten. In contrast, just 10 percent of parents reported positive reactions from their teenage children when they shared their favorite music. Some 79 percent of fathers said they had tried to influence their children's music, but just 69 percent of mothers. However, mothers were more effective, with 38 percent reporting that their kids loved the tunes they shared, compared to 30 percent of dads who, in some cases, said their children cried or even fell asleep.
lines.zh: 然而，时间至关重要，因为父母的影响最有可能在十岁以前这一关键时期发挥作用。进入青春期后，孩子往往会逐渐远离父母的选择，并更多地受到同龄人的影响。音乐流媒体服务Deezer对2000名英国父母进行的另一项调查也发现，近五分之四的父母认为，孩子在十岁以前更容易接受他们的音乐建议。相比之下，只有10%的父母表示，孩子进入青少年时期后，在他们分享自己喜爱的音乐时会作出积极反应。约79%的父亲表示曾试图影响孩子的音乐选择，而母亲的这一比例仅为69%。不过，母亲的影响更有效：38%的母亲表示孩子喜欢她们分享的曲调，而父亲中只有30%的人得到这样的反馈；有些父亲甚至表示，孩子听着听着哭了起来，或者睡着了。

lines.en: Dr. Egermann claims introducing children to a variety of musical styles is the key to fostering good taste in later life. "By playing children a variety of genres before this critical period, research on familiarization suggests they will enjoy lots of different types of music as adults," he added. The benefits of having a wider taste in music include the ability to manage their emotions more effectively, socialize and bond with others more easily, and to have a better understanding of other cultures as well.
lines.zh: 埃格尔曼博士认为，让孩子接触各种各样的音乐风格，是培养他们日后良好音乐品味的关键。他补充说：“有关熟悉化的研究表明，在这一关键时期之前让孩子聆听多种音乐类型，他们成年后将会喜欢许多不同种类的音乐。”拥有更广泛的音乐品味所带来的益处包括更有效地管理情绪、更容易与他人交往并建立联系，以及更好地理解其他文化。

lines.en: Dr. Egermann advises parents not to push their favorite music too hard on their children, but instead play it as background music while a child is playing. They can also help create positive memories about artists and bands by going to concerts and live music events together.
lines.zh: 埃格尔曼博士建议，父母不要过分强迫孩子接受自己喜爱的音乐，而应在孩子玩耍时将其作为背景音乐播放。他们还可以通过一起参加音乐会和现场音乐活动，帮助孩子对音乐家和乐队形成积极的记忆。

passages.en: Most financial crises have plenty in common: they tend to start in the banking sector and involve excessive borrowing, together with an asset bubble. The __(26)__ crisis of 2008 was no different, with the asset bubble focused on US real estate. But my research suggests this crisis had another __(27)__ cause—that some people in the banking sector were playing or "gaming" the system for their own financial gain.
passages.zh: 大多数金融危机都有许多共同之处：它们往往始于银行业，并伴随着过度借贷和资产泡沫。2008年的全球危机也不例外，只是当时的资产泡沫集中在美国房地产市场。但我的研究表明，这场危机还有另一个根本原因——银行业中的一些人为了谋取个人经济利益而操纵或“钻”制度的空子。

passages.en: The game being played had several important features. The first was the deliberate complexity of the financial products at its core. Then there are the __(28)__ biases that permeate decision-making at all levels of the banking industry. Banking often attracts people with certain personality __(29)__ , including those who are overconfident and take excessive risks.
passages.zh: 当时所进行的这种操纵具有几个重要特征。首先是其核心金融产品经过了刻意设计，十分复杂。其次，行为偏差渗透到了银行业各个层面的决策过程中。银行业往往会吸引具有某些性格特征的人，其中包括过度自信、过度承担风险的人。

passages.en: Such people tend to like complexity for its own sake, but they often do not fully understand the __(30)__ of that complexity for the stability of the financial system as a whole. Often they do not care—they are primarily interested in gaming the system to __(31)__ their bonuses.
passages.zh: 这类人往往会为了复杂而复杂地追求复杂性，但他们通常并不完全理解这种复杂性对整个金融体系稳定性的影响。很多时候，他们并不在乎这些影响——他们主要关心的是操纵制度，以使自己的奖金最大化。

passages.en: The next element is risk. There are parts of the banking sector that will always be __(32)__ to risk, but many bankers have come to feel immune to its potential impact, because they __(33)__ that, however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there to bail them out.
passages.zh: 下一个要素是风险。银行业中有些领域始终容易受到风险影响，但许多银行家逐渐觉得自己不会受到风险潜在影响，因为他们认定，无论银行的行为多么鲁莽，政府总会出手救助它们。

passages.en: Gaming in the banking sector seems virtually impossible to __(34)__ . The only effective measure to end it would be to make bankers __(35)__ liable for losses, but no government has ever passed such a law, and no single government could do so on its own, since this would immediately cause their entire national banking sector to move wholesale to another jurisdiction.
passages.zh: 银行业中的这种制度操纵几乎不可能被消除。终结这种行为的唯一有效措施，是让银行家个人对损失承担责任；但从未有任何政府通过这样的法律，而且任何单一政府也无法独自这样做，因为这会立即导致本国整个银行业大规模迁往其他司法管辖区。

rows.text: D) global形容词
冠词与名词之间锁形容词
2008年全球金融危机 "2008年全球金融危机"是常识性固定表述；文本证据同样充分——上句 Most financial crises have plenty in common 谈"多数金融危机"的共性，本句说这场危机 no different（也不例外），是在把单场危机放进普遍、整体的尺度里讨论，global 与 Most financial crises 的宏阔范围呼应。

A)behavioural主题词提前抢跑 全文确实讲行为因素，很多考生会因此把 behavioural 按在这里——但 26 空修饰的是"危机"的规模/范围维度，行为分析后文才展开；behavioural crisis 非惯用表达，behavioural 真正的家在 28 空 the ___ biases。 C)fragilefragile不修饰危机 fragile 意为"脆弱的"，惯用 fragile economy / system；crisis 本身是坏事，再说"脆弱的危机"逻辑别扭。 G)overlapping重叠的危机无文本支撑 overlapping 意为"重叠的"，文中没有任何"多场危机重叠"的信息；2008 是一场特定危机，overlapping 属无中生有。 J)proneprone必带to不作前置定语 prone 的惯用结构是 be prone to sth，几乎不直接放名词前作定语（a prone crisis 不成立）；它的正确位置在 32 空 be ___ to risk 的框架里。 O)underlyingunderlying修饰原因不修饰危机 underlying 意为"根本的、潜在的"，惯用 underlying cause / reason；修饰 crisis 语义勉强，而它正是 27 空 another ___ cause 的标准答案。
O) underlying形容词
another与名词之间锁形容词

表层共性之下的根本原因 首段先说这场危机与多数危机有共性（银行业、过度借贷、资产泡沫），随即 But 转折：But my research suggests this crisis had another __(27)__ cause——在众目所见的共性原因**之外/之下**还有一个"根本的"原因。underlying（根本的、潜藏的）正好承载 But 的对比：表面原因人尽皆知，underlying cause 才是作者研究的新发现；破折号后"银行从业者为私利操纵系统"正是这个深层原因的内容。

A)behavioural主题词眼熟乱选 本卷最阴的干扰：全文确实讲行为因素，behavioural cause 看似点题——但破折号引出的解释强调的是"此前未被点破的深层原因"，重在"潜藏"而非"行为的"；且 28 空 the ___ biases 只能由 behavioural 填（behavioural biases 是行为金融学术语），在此提前用掉它，28 空将无词可填。 C)fragile脆弱的原因搭配不通 fragile 修饰 cause 语义不通——"脆弱的原因"既非惯用搭配，也与破折号后的操纵行为无关。 G)overlapping重叠的原因无中生有 文中只讲"另一个"原因，没有任何"多个原因重叠"的信息，overlapping 属无中生有。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 A) —— 主题词眼熟加篇章呼应的假正当。全文主题就是行为因素，behavioural cause 读起来像点题，词性也对、词义也沾边，是本卷错误率最高的选法。但 another __(27)__ cause—that some people in the banking sector were playing or "gaming" the system 的破折号解释强调的是"此前未被点破的深层原因"，且 28 空 the ___ biases 只能由 behavioural 填（术语搭配）。防坑一句话：主题词先查它的命定搭配位置，别在第一眼像的空提前用掉。
A) behavioural形容词
the与名词之间锁形容词

行为偏差渗透各级决策 behavioural biases（行为偏差）是行为经济学/金融学的标准术语，指人的系统性心理偏差；下句 Banking often attracts people with certain personality traits, including those who are overconfident and take excessive risks 的"过度自信、冒大险"正是 behavioural biases 的具体表现，与空后的 permeate decision-making（渗透各级决策）浑然一体。

C)fragile脆弱的偏差语义错位 fragile 修饰的是系统、经济等会"破碎"的实体，biases（偏差）无所谓脆弱与否；"脆弱的偏差渗透决策"语义不通。 G)overlapping重叠的偏差似是而非 overlapping biases 字面上能组合，是最后的诱惑；但下文所举"过度自信、爱冒险"是类型不同的偏差而非"互相重叠"，且 overlapping 与"渗透各级决策"的普遍性描写无关——文中没有任何"重叠"信息。
N) traits名词
personality后缺中心名词
personality traits固定搭配 personality traits（人格特质）是心理学与日常英语的固定搭配；更直接的证据在空后：including those who are overconfident and take excessive risks 用 including 举例——过度自信、冒大险正是"人格特质"的具体内容，例子在给空位下定义。

E)implications与personality不构成搭配 implications 意为"影响、含义"，惯用 implications of/for sth；personality implications 不是惯用表达，且后文所举"过度自信、爱冒险"是人自身的特质，不是某种"影响"。 K)prototypes原型与人格描写脱节 prototypes 指产品或模型的"原型、雏形"，是具体物；银行业吸引的是具有某些人格特质的人，"人格原型"与 overconfident、take excessive risks 的描写对不上。
E) implications名词
the与of夹出名词
复杂性对稳定的后果 implications of A for B（A对B的影响/后果）是高频双介词搭配，与空后的 of that complexity for the stability 框架完全吻合；"他们并不完全理解那种复杂性对整个金融体系稳定性的影响"，又与下句 Often they do not care 衔接自然——不理解影响，所以不在乎。
K)prototypes原型与抽象语境不符 prototypes 指具体产品/模型的"原型"，而本空要接的是抽象概念 complexity 与 stability 之间的关系；"复杂性的原型"语义不通。
F) maximise动词
目的不定式to后接动词原形
操纵系统为了奖金最大化 全文主旨即银行家为私利操纵系统：playing or "gaming" the system for their own financial gain。操纵系统的目的自然是让自己的奖金**最大化**，maximise their bonuses 与 for their own financial gain 同义呼应，主旨与搭配双重锁定。

B)eliminate逻辑指向相反 eliminate 意为"消除"，eliminate their bonuses＝取消自己的奖金，与 for their own financial gain 的逐利动机完全相反——典型"正话反说"型干扰。 I)presume接不了bonuses这个宾语 presume 作"假定"讲时多接 that 从句或 presume sth to be；presume their bonuses（"假定他们的奖金"）语义不通，操纵系统不是为了"假定奖金"。 L)reassure宾语须为人 reassure 的宾语通常是人（reassure sb），意为"使某人安心"；reassure their bonuses 搭配不成立，"让奖金安心"拟人化得毫无道理。
J) prone形容词
be与to夹出表语形容词

be prone to固定搭配 be prone to sth（易于遭受……）是词典级固定搭配，"银行业总有些部分永远容易遭受风险"；且与后半句 but many bankers have come to feel immune to its potential impact 的 immune to（对……免疫）形成对照：客观上 prone to risk、主观上 feel immune——but 转折严丝合缝。

A)behaviouralbehavioural不作表语接to behavioural（行为的）只作前置定语修饰名词（behavioural biases），be behavioural to risk 结构不成立。 C)fragilefragile to搭配不地道 fragile 语义上与 risk 沾边、最具迷惑性；但英语惯用 be fragile 单独作表语或 be vulnerable to，be fragile to risk 不是地道搭配——六级常考"词义对但搭配错"这一坑。 G)overlapping与risk语义不接 overlapping（重叠的）与 risk 连用语义不通，银行部门"重叠于风险"不知所云。 O)underlying不作表语形容词接to underlying（潜在的）多作前置定语（underlying cause），be underlying to risk 结构不成立。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 C) —— 词义沾边但搭配不地道。"对风险脆弱"按中文思维完全通顺，fragile 词性也对；但英语惯用 be prone / vulnerable to risk，be fragile to 不是地道搭配。防坑一句话：当中文直译很顺而英文搭配陌生时，信搭配（be prone to），不信直译。
I) presume动词
主语后缺谓语且接that从句

他们认定政府必兜底 that 从句的内容 however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there to bail them out（无论银行多鲁莽，政府总会救助）正是银行家一种想当然的认定；正因为 presume 如此，上句 many bankers have come to feel immune to its potential impact（觉得风险伤不到自己）才成立，因果链完整。
L)reassure句式结构不成立 reassure 的正确结构是 reassure sb that...（使某人相信……），必须带人作宾语；they reassure that... 缺宾语、结构不成立——两个词义虽都沾"相信"的边，句式直接判生死。
B) eliminate动词
impossible to后接动词原形
操纵行为几乎无法消除 主语 Gaming（操纵行为）是空位的逻辑宾语，"银行业的操纵行为几乎不可能被__"；下句 The only effective measure to end it 的 end it（终结它）正是 eliminate 的同义改写，语义直接锁定——只有"消除/终结"才接得上"唯一有效办法"。
I)presume与行为现象搭配无义 "几乎不可能去假定操纵行为"语义不通；presume 的宾语应是某个判断或事实，不是一种行为现象，且 presume 更合 33 空 they ___ that 从句的句式。 L)reassure宾语须为人且逻辑相反 reassure 意为"使安心"，宾语须是人；"不可能去安抚操纵行为"搭配不当，且与下句"终结它"的指向相反。
H) personally副词
修饰形容词liable须用副词
personally liable法律追责搭配 本段谈"终结操纵的唯一有效办法是让银行家__对损失负责"，下句 but no government has ever passed such a law 表明这是在讲法律层面的追责；personally liable（个人承担法律责任）是法律英语惯用搭配，"追到个人"才解释了为何没有政府敢立此法。
M)skeptically词义与搭配双不符 skeptically 意为"怀疑地"，惯常修饰 say、look at 这类言行动词；skeptically liable 既非常见搭配，"怀疑地承担责任"语义也不成立，且与下文追责语境完全脱节。

longreading.title: 2026年6月·第2套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) Five hundred years ago, forests covered much of the Iberian peninsula. But that soon changed. Centuries of wars and invasions, agricultural expansion and woodcutting for firewood and shipping wiped out most of the woods and transformed places like Matamorisca, a small village in northern Spain, into degraded landscapes.
passages.zh: 五百年前，森林覆盖了伊比利亚半岛的大部分地区。但这种情况很快发生了改变。数百年的战争和入侵、农业扩张，以及为取暖和造船而砍伐木材，使大部分森林消失，并将西班牙北部的小村庄Matamorisca等地变成了退化的景观。

passages.en: B) The region's dry climate and depleted soils would be a recipe for disaster in your average program to replant trees, but for the Amsterdam-based Land Life Company it's an ideal place. "We typically operate where nature does not come back by itself," says Jurrian Ruys, its CEO. "We go where there are rougher conditions in terms of weather, with rough or very hot summers." In Matamorisca, they intervened in 17 barren hectares owned by the regional government and peppered them with their signature device: a biodegradable(可生物降解的) cardboard container they call the cocoon which can hold 25 litres of water underground to aid a seedling's first year. Around 16,000 trees, including oaks, ashes, walnuts, rowans, and whitebeams, were planted in May 2018, and the company reports that 96% of them survived that year's burning hot summer without extra irrigation, a critical milestone for a young tree.
passages.zh: 该地区干燥的气候和贫瘠的土壤，对于一般的植树造林计划来说将是灾难的根源，但对于总部位于阿姆斯特丹的Land Life Company而言，这里却是理想之地。该公司的首席执行官Jurrian Ruys说：“我们通常在自然无法自行恢复的地方开展工作。我们会前往天气条件更为恶劣、夏季较为艰苦或极其炎热的地方。”在Matamorisca，他们对地方政府拥有的17公顷贫瘠土地进行了干预，并在其中布置了他们的标志性设备：一种可生物降解的纸板容器，他们称之为“茧”，可以在地下储存25升水，以帮助幼苗度过第一年。2018年5月，他们种下了约1.6万棵树，包括橡树、白蜡树、核桃树、花楸树和白檀树。公司报告称，其中96%的树木在当年酷热的夏季中没有额外灌溉也存活了下来，这对幼树而言是一个关键的里程碑。

passages.en: C) "Does nature return by itself?" asks Arnout Asjes, Land Life Company's chief technology officer, who oversees a mix of drone(无人机) and satellite imagery, big data analysis, soil enhancement, QR(二维码) tagging and site-specific tree configuration designs. "Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up."
passages.zh: Land Life Company的首席技术官Arnout Asjes负责统筹无人机和卫星影像、大数据分析、土壤改良、二维码标记以及因地制宜的树木配置设计。他问道：“自然会自行恢复吗？或许会，但可能需要几十年甚至几百年，所以我们正在加快这一进程。”

passages.en: D) His company belongs to a global movement of organisations trying to save degraded or deforested areas, ranging from fertile tropical lowlands to dry hills in temperate(温带的) regions. Spurred by global biodiversity loss and climate change, these groups are pushing the boundary of how to revive forest cover. "It's not a theoretical proposition," says Walter Vergara, a forest and climate specialist at the World Resources Institute(WRI). "It requires the right incentives, the right stakeholders, the right analysis and sufficient capital, but it can happen."
passages.zh: 他的公司属于一个全球性运动，该运动由一系列试图拯救退化或遭到砍伐的地区的组织组成，这些地区从肥沃的热带低地到温带地区的干燥丘陵不等。在全球生物多样性丧失和气候变化的推动下，这些组织正在拓展恢复森林覆盖的可能性。世界资源研究所（WRI）的森林与气候专家Walter Vergara说：“这不是一个理论上的设想。它需要正确的激励机制、正确的利益相关者、正确的分析和充足的资金，但这是可以实现的。”

passages.en: E) How these factors come together for a particular project—and whether saving destroyed woods is even possible—depends on what kind of ecosystem you have in mind. Secondary forests in the Amazon are different from Texas pines recovering after wildfires or the Arctic timber woods that cover much of Sweden. Each provides different reasons for reforestation programs and each has particular needs. In the dry conditions around Matamorisca and similar areas in Spain, Land Life Company worries about rapid desertification(沙漠化). As its focus is on restoring an ecosystem, it works with organisations that don't expect their money back.
passages.zh: 这些因素如何结合到某个具体项目中，以及拯救遭到破坏的森林是否真的可行，取决于你设想的生态系统类型。亚马孙地区的次生林，与野火后正在恢复的得克萨斯州松林，或覆盖瑞典大部分地区的北极森林，都各不相同。每种生态系统都有不同的理由促使人们实施重新造林计划，也各自有特别的需求。在Matamorisca周边及西班牙类似地区的干燥环境中，Land Life Company担心的是迅速发生的沙漠化。由于该公司的重点是恢复生态系统，因此它与那些不指望收回资金的组织合作。

passages.en: F) With around 600 hectares replanted around the world since 2015 and another 1,100 planned for this year, the company's drive fits into the Bonn Challenge, a global effort to restore 150 million hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land by 2020. That's an area roughly the size of Iran or Mongolia. By 2030, the goal is to reach 350 million hectares—20% more land than India. These targets include both the rehabilitation of forested areas that have lost density or look a bit weak (a process known as 'restoration' in forestry jargon) and the recovery of forest cover in areas where it was completely cleared (what's known as 'reforestation').
passages.zh: 自2015年以来，该公司已在世界各地重新种植了约600公顷土地，今年还计划再种植1100公顷，这项事业与“波恩挑战”相契合。“波恩挑战”是一项全球性行动，旨在到2020年恢复世界上1.5亿公顷被砍伐和退化的土地。这一面积大致相当于伊朗或蒙古的国土面积。到2030年，目标是达到3.5亿公顷，比印度的国土面积多20%。这些目标既包括对森林密度下降或状况有所衰退的林区进行修复（林业术语称为“恢复”），也包括在森林覆盖曾被完全清除的地区恢复森林覆盖（即所谓的“重新造林”）。

passages.en: G) That global target is broken into smaller pieces and takes shape in Latin America as the 20x20 Initiative, an effort to contribute 20 million hectares to the overall goal by initiating small to medium projects with the political backing of governments. Unlike Land Life Company, this region-wide project makes the economic and business case for reforestation, even though they are after biodiversity conservation. "You need to bring in private sector money," says WRI's Vergara, who leads the initiative, "and that capital needs to see a return on their investment." A study he led predicts Latin America would see an estimated net present value of about $23bn over a 50-year period if it reaches its goal.
passages.zh: 这一全球目标被分解成更小的部分，在拉丁美洲则以“20x20倡议”的形式展开。这项倡议在各国政府的政治支持下，通过启动中小型项目，为总体目标贡献2000万公顷土地。与Land Life Company不同，这一覆盖整个地区的项目着眼于重新造林的经济和商业价值，尽管其目的在于保护生物多样性。负责领导该倡议的世界资源研究所Vergara说：“你需要引入私营部门的资金，而这些资金需要看到投资回报。”他领导的一项研究预测，如果拉丁美洲实现这一目标，那么在50年间预计可获得约230亿美元的净现值。

passages.en: H) Money can come from timber sales in sustainably managed forests or from harvesting 'non-wood products' like nuts, oils and fruits from the trees. You can take note of how much carbon dioxide your forest is capturing and sell carbon credits to companies keen to offset their emissions. Or you can even grow the forest hoping that biodiversity will attract ecotourists who'd pay for lodging, birdwatching tours and meals.
passages.zh: 资金可以来自可持续经营森林的木材销售，也可以来自采集树上的坚果、油料和水果等“非木材产品”。你可以记录森林吸收了多少二氧化碳，并向那些急于抵消自身排放的公司出售碳信用额度。或者，你甚至可以培育森林，希望生物多样性能够吸引生态旅游者，让他们为住宿、观鸟之旅和餐饮付费。

passages.en: I) Still, these backers are not your high-street bank. Money for the 20x20 Initiative comes mostly from financial organisations with triple goal—a modest return on their investment, environmental benefits and social gains—known as impact investors. Take the German fund 12Tree for instance, one of the 20x20 partners. It put $9.5 million into Cuango, a 1,455-hectare property on the Caribbean coast of Panama that combines a commercial cocoa tree plantation with timber extraction from a sustainably managed secondary forest. With their money, they reforested a former cattle ranch, provided high-quality jobs for the surrounding communities and made a return on their investment.
passages.zh: 不过，这些支持者并不是普通的商业银行。“20x20倡议”的资金主要来自具有三重目标的金融机构：获得适度的投资回报、取得环境效益以及实现社会收益，这些机构被称为影响力投资者。以德国基金12Tree为例，它是“20x20倡议”的合作伙伴之一。该基金向Cuango投入了950万美元。Cuango位于巴拿马加勒比海沿岸，占地1455公顷，将商业可可种植园与从可持续经营的次生林中采伐木材结合起来。借助这笔资金，他们在一处曾经的牧牛场上重新造林，为周边社区提供了高质量的就业机会，并获得了投资回报。

passages.en: J) Even on land cleared decades ago and currently used by farmers, some crops can coexist with the forest, if you find the right balance. Although not technically reforestation, agroforestry (a system of land use in which harvestable trees or shrubs are grown among or around crops or on pasture land, as a means of preserving or enhancing the productivity of the land) provides an opportunity for small-holder farmers to sustain their livelihoods while adding some forest cover to their farms.
passages.zh: 即使是在数十年前被清理、目前由农民使用的土地上，只要找到适当的平衡，一些农作物也可以与森林共存。农林业虽然在技术上不属于重新造林，但它是一种土地利用系统，即在农作物之间或周围、或者牧场上种植可采收的树木或灌木，以保持或提高土地的生产力。它为小农户维持生计提供了机会，同时也能在农场中增加一定的森林覆盖。

passages.en: K) A global project called Breedcafs is studying how trees behave in coffee farms, hoping to find crop varieties that manage to grow under the shade of trees. Coffee grows naturally in such forests, so copying that in farms is taking the crop back to its roots. "By reintroducing trees in the landscape, we impact positively humidity, rain capture, soil conservation and biodiversity preservation," says coffee expert Benoit Bertrand, who leads the project from the French Agricultural Research Centre for International Development. Bertrand is analysing which of dozens of coffee varieties fits better for this system. A similar approach can be applied to land with cocoa, vanilla and fruit trees.
passages.zh: 一项名为Breedcafs的全球性项目正在研究树木在咖啡农场中的生长状况，希望找到能够在树荫下生长的作物品种。咖啡在这类森林中自然生长，因此在农场中复制这种环境，就是让这种作物回归其根源。该项目由法国国际发展农业研究中心的咖啡专家Benoit Bertrand负责。他说：“通过在景观中重新引入树木，我们能够积极改善湿度、雨水截留、土壤保护和生物多样性保护。”Bertrand正在分析数十种咖啡品种，以确定哪一种更适合这一系统。类似的方法也可以应用于种植可可、香草和果树的土地。

passages.en: L) Not every piece of land is fit for reforestation. Vergara's partners look for safe investments, and even Land Life Company only runs major projects in what they consider "low-risk" countries. "We tend to avoid large-scale operations in countries in some parts of the Middle East or Africa where the permanence is not secured," says Ruys.
passages.zh: 并非每一块土地都适合重新造林。Vergara的合作伙伴寻找的是安全的投资，甚至Land Life Company也只在他们认为“低风险”的国家开展大型项目。Ruys说：“在中东或非洲的一些国家，由于无法确保森林的长期存续，我们往往会避免在那里开展大规模项目。”

passages.en: M) But in the right location, perhaps all you need is time. In the Central Pacific of Costa Rica, the 330-hectare National Wildlife Refuge Baru looks nothing like the cattle ranch it was before 1987, when Jack Ewing decided to turn this large estate into an ecotourism destination. Instead of intervening, a friend told him to let nature have its way. Baru's former grazing lands are now thriving woods and the property boasts over 150 hectares of secondary forests with no intervention from humans. In the past 10 years, animals such as howling monkeys, scarlet macaws and even migratory cougars have returned to the refuge's land, boosting tourism and revitalising the ecosystem. Ewing, now 75, explains this success using the words his friend chose three decades ago: "In Costa Rica, when you stop managing the shrubs, the jungle comes back for its revenge."
passages.zh: 但在合适的地点，也许你所需要的只是一点时间。在哥斯达黎加中太平洋地区，占地330公顷的Baru国家野生动物保护区与1987年以前的牧牛场完全不同。那一年，Jack Ewing决定将这片大型地产改造成生态旅游目的地。一位朋友告诉他，与其进行干预，不如听任自然发展。如今，Baru昔日的牧场已经变成了繁茂的森林，这片地产拥有超过150公顷的次生林，且没有受到人类干预。在过去10年里，吼猴、猩红金刚鹦鹉，甚至迁徙的美洲狮等动物重新回到了保护区的土地上，推动了旅游业发展，也使生态系统恢复了活力。现年75岁的Ewing用那位朋友30年前说过的话解释了这一成功：“在哥斯达黎加，当你不再管理灌木丛时，丛林就会回来复仇。”

statements.en: Land Life Company's efforts fit into the global goal to restore millions of hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land.
statements.zh: Land Life Company 的努力符合全球恢复数百万公顷被砍伐和退化土地的目标。

analysis.定位: F 段 With around 600 hectares replanted around the world since 2015 and another 1,100 planned for this year, the company's drive fits into the Bonn Challenge, a global effort to restore 150 million hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land by 2020. 自2015年以來，該公司已在全球重植約600公頃土地，今年還計劃再植1100公頃；這一努力契合了「波恩挑戰」——一項到2020年恢復全球1.5億公頃被砍伐與退化土地的全球目標。
analysis.改写: Land Life Company's efforts↔the company's drive 同義替換 efforts = drive fit into the global goal↔fits into the Bonn Challenge, a global effort global goal 被具體化為 Bonn Challenge to restore millions of hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land↔to restore 150 million hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land 數字具體化
analysis.辨邻: B peppered them with their signature device 等內容聚焦 cocoon 技術與2018年造林，並未出現 Bonn Challenge 或百萬公頃目標。 The region's dry climate and depleted soils would be a recipe for disaster in your average program to replant trees

statements.en: Planting trees or shrubs together with crops can help improve the yield of the land, while offering small-scale farmers a chance to make a living.
statements.zh: 将树木或灌木与农作物一起种植，有助于提高土地的产量，同时为小规模农户提供谋生的机会。

analysis.锚点: trees or shrubs with crops / small-scale farmers
analysis.定位: J 段 Although not technically reforestation, agroforestry (a system of land use in which harvestable trees or shrubs are grown among or around crops or on pasture land, as a means of preserving or enhancing the productivity of the land) provides an opportunity for small-holder farmers to sustain their livelihoods while adding some forest cover to their farms. 雖然嚴格來說不算重新造林，但農林業（一種土地利用體系，即在作物周圍或之間、或牧場上種植可採收的樹木或灌木，以保持或提高土地生產力）為小農提供了在維持生計的同時為農場增加些許森林覆蓋的機會。
analysis.改写: Planting trees or shrubs together with crops↔trees or shrubs are grown among or around crops 動作與對象的同義改寫 help improve the yield of the land↔enhancing the productivity of the land yield 與 productivity 同義 offering small-scale farmers a chance to make a living↔provides an opportunity for small-holder farmers to sustain their livelihoods 句式重構＋同義替換
analysis.辨邻: K A global project called Breedcafs is studying how trees behave in coffee farms 雖涉及 trees 與 crops，但聚焦尋找咖啡品種，未提及 small-holder farmers 或維持生計。 A global project called Breedcafs is studying how trees behave in coffee farms

statements.en: One reforestation project bases its argument on economic benefits and investment returns.
statements.zh: 一个重新造林项目以经济效益和投资回报为依据。

analysis.定位: G 段 Unlike Land Life Company, this region-wide project makes the economic and business case for reforestation, even though they are after biodiversity conservation. 'You need to bring in private sector money,' says WRI's Vergara, who leads the initiative, 'and that capital needs to see a return on their investment.' A study he led predicts Latin America would see an estimated net present value of about $23bn over a 50-year period if it reaches its goal. 與 Land Life Company 不同，這個覆蓋全區域的項目為重新造林提出了經濟與商業理由，儘管他們也追求生物多樣性保護。「你需要引入私營部門資金，」主持該倡議的 WRI 的 Vergara 說，「而且這筆資本需要看到投資回報。」他主導的一項研究預測，若目標達成，拉丁美洲在50年內將獲得約230億美元的淨現值。
analysis.改写: One reforestation project↔this region-wide project 概括指代 bases its argument on economic benefits↔makes the economic and business case for reforestation argument 與 case 同義 and investment returns↔that capital needs to see a return on their investment 投資回報的同義表達
analysis.辨邻: H Money can come from timber sales 等雖談經濟回報，但它是「如何賺錢」的清單，而非「某項目以經濟回報為論證」的陳述。 Money can come from timber sales in sustainably managed forests

statements.en: With time, nature may return to its original state without human intervention if the location is appropriate.
statements.zh: 随着时间的推移，如果地点合适，即使没有人类干预，大自然也可能恢复到原来的状态。

analysis.定位: M 段 But in the right location, perhaps all you need is time. In the Central Pacific of Costa Rica, the 330-hectare National Wildlife Refuge Baru looks nothing like the cattle ranch it was before 1987, when Jack Ewing decided to turn this large estate into an ecotourism destination. Instead of intervening, a friend told him to let nature have its way. Baru's former grazing lands are now thriving woods and the property boasts over 150 hectares of secondary forests with no intervention from humans. 但在合適的地點，或許你所需要的只是時間。在哥斯大黎加中太平洋地區，330公頃的 Baru 國家野生動物保護區看起來已完全不像1987年之前的那片牧場——當時 Jack Ewing 決定將這片大產地改為生態旅遊目的地。一位朋友告訴他不要干預，讓自然自行其是。Baru 曾經的放牧地如今已是茂盛的林地，該地產擁有超過150公頃未經人類干預的次生林。
analysis.改写: With time, nature may return to its original state↔Baru's former grazing lands are now thriving woods and the property boasts over 150 hectares of secondary forests 語義概括 without human intervention↔no intervention from humans 同義改寫 if the location is appropriate↔in the right location 同義替換
analysis.辨邻: C it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up 與題幹的 without human intervention 方向相反。 it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up

statements.en: According to a forest and climate expert, the revival of forest cover can take place under the necessary conditions.
statements.zh: 一位森林与气候专家表示，在具备必要条件的情况下，森林覆盖可以得到恢复。

analysis.锚点: forest and climate expert / necessary conditions
analysis.定位: D 段 Spurred by global biodiversity loss and climate change, these groups are pushing the boundary of how to revive forest cover. 'It's not a theoretical proposition,' says Walter Vergara, a forest and climate specialist at the World Resources Institute(WRI). 'It requires the right incentives, the right stakeholders, the right analysis and sufficient capital, but it can happen.' 受全球生物多樣性喪失和氣候變化的驅使，這些組織正在突破如何恢復森林覆蓋的邊界。「這不是一個理論命題，」世界資源研究所（WRI）的森林與氣候專家 Walter Vergara 說，「它需要正確的激勵、正確的利益相關者、正確的分析和充足的資本，但這是可以實現的。」
analysis.改写: According to a forest and climate expert↔says Walter Vergara, a forest and climate specialist at the World Resources Institute(WRI) 身份同義替換 the revival of forest cover↔revive forest cover 名詞化 can take place under the necessary conditions↔It requires the right incentives, the right stakeholders, the right analysis and sufficient capital, but it can happen 語義概括
analysis.辨邻: G 'You need to bring in private sector money,' says WRI's Vergara 與題幹的 revival of forest cover can take place under necessary conditions 話題不同。 'You need to bring in private sector money,' says WRI's Vergara, who leads the initiative

statements.en: One company runs its major operations exclusively in countries where risks are not high.
statements.zh: 一家公司的主要业务完全在风险不高的国家开展。

analysis.锚点: risks are not high / major operations
analysis.定位: L 段 Vergara's partners look for safe investments, and even Land Life Company only runs major projects in what they consider 'low-risk' countries. 'We tend to avoid large-scale operations in countries in some parts of the Middle East or Africa where the permanence is not secured,' says Ruys. Vergara 的合作伙伴尋找安全投資，就連 Land Life Company 也只在他們認為「低風險」的國家開展重大項目。「我們傾向於避免在中東或非洲部分國家開展大規模行動，因為那裡的持久性無法得到保障，」Ruys 說。
analysis.改写: One company↔Land Life Company 上下文指代 runs its major operations↔only runs major projects 同義替換 exclusively in countries where risks are not high↔in what they consider 'low-risk' countries 同義替換＋語序調整
analysis.辨邻: G Unlike Land Life Company, this region-wide project makes the economic and business case for reforestation 雖提及 Land Life Company，但對比的是經濟模式，不是風險標準。 Unlike Land Life Company, this region-wide project makes the economic and business case for reforestation

statements.en: Left alone, nature may take scores of years or even centuries to repair itself.
statements.zh: 如果任其自然，大自然可能需要数十年甚至数百年的时间才能自我修复。

analysis.锚点: scores of years or even centuries
analysis.定位: C 段 'Does nature return by itself?' asks Arnout Asjes, Land Life Company's chief technology officer, who oversees a mix of drone and satellite imagery, big data analysis, soil enhancement, QR tagging and site-specific tree configuration designs. 'Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up.' 「自然能自行恢復嗎？」Land Life Company 的首席技術官 Arnout Asjes 問道，他負責監管無人機與衛星圖像、大數據分析、土壤改良、二維碼標籤和因地制宜的樹木配置設計。「可能可以，但這需要數十年或數百年，所以我們正在加速這一過程。」
analysis.改写: Left alone, nature may take scores of years or even centuries to repair itself↔'Does nature return by itself?' asks Arnout Asjes...'Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years' 多組同義替換疊加
analysis.辨邻: M But in the right location, perhaps all you need is time 與 no intervention from humans 強調的是不介入即可恢復，而非「需要數十到數百年」。 But in the right location, perhaps all you need is time

statements.en: Economic returns can be derived from selling timber and non-wood products as well as carbon credits.
statements.zh: 通过出售木材和非木材产品以及碳信用额，可以获得经济回报。

analysis.定位: H 段 Money can come from timber sales in sustainably managed forests or from harvesting 'non-wood products' like nuts, oils and fruits from the trees. You can take note of how much carbon dioxide your forest is capturing and sell carbon credits to companies keen to offset their emissions. Or you can even grow the forest hoping that biodiversity will attract ecotourists who'd pay for lodging, birdwatching tours and meals. 資金可以來自可持續管理森林中的木材銷售，或從樹上收穫「非木材產品」如堅果、油和水果。你可以記錄森林吸收了多少二氧化碳，然後把碳信用賣給希望抵消排放的公司。或者你甚至可以培育森林，寄望生物多樣性會吸引願意支付住宿、觀鳥旅行和餐飲費用的生態旅遊者。
analysis.改写: Economic returns↔Money can come from 語義概括 selling timber↔timber sales 動名詞轉換 non-wood products↔'non-wood products' 原樣復現 carbon credits↔sell carbon credits 原樣復現
analysis.辨邻: I Take the German fund 12Tree for instance 舉例說明投資回報，但沒有並列出 timber、non-wood products、carbon credits 這三項。 Take the German fund 12Tree for instance, one of the 20x20 partners

statements.en: A study is under way across the world to look for crops that can grow among trees.
statements.zh: 一项研究正在世界各地开展，旨在寻找能够在树木之间生长的农作物。

analysis.定位: K 段 A global project called Breedcafs is studying how trees behave in coffee farms, hoping to find crop varieties that manage to grow under the shade of trees. Coffee grows naturally in such forests, so copying that in farms is taking the crop back to its roots. 'By reintroducing trees in the landscape, we impact positively humidity, rain capture, soil conservation and biodiversity preservation,' says coffee expert Benoit Bertrand, who leads the project from the French Agricultural Research Centre for International Development. Bertrand is analysing which of dozens of coffee varieties fits better for this system. 一個名為 Breedcafs 的全球項目正在研究咖啡農場中樹木的生長情況，希望找到能在樹蔭下生長的作物品種。咖啡天然生長於這樣的森林中，因此在農場中模仿這種做法等於讓作物回歸本源。「通過在景觀中重新引入樹木，我們積極影響濕度、雨水截留、土壤保護和生物多樣性保護，」在法國農業國際合作研究中心領導該項目的咖啡專家 Benoit Bertrand 說。Bertrand 正在分析數十種咖啡品種中哪一種更適合這一系統。
analysis.改写: A study is under way across the world↔A global project called Breedcafs is studying 同義改寫 to look for crops that can grow among trees↔hoping to find crop varieties that manage to grow under the shade of trees 同義替換＋語境細化
analysis.辨邻: J agroforestry (a system of land use in which harvestable trees or shrubs are grown among or around crops or on pasture land) 雖涉及 crops 與 trees，但沒有 Breedcafs、coffee farms 或研究品種的內容。 agroforestry (a system of land use in which harvestable trees or shrubs are grown among or around crops or on pasture land)

statements.en: Land Life Company's operations are usually located where reforestation is impossible without human intervention.
statements.zh: Land Life Company 的业务通常位于没有人类干预就不可能重新造林的地方。

analysis.锚点: Land Life Company / without human intervention
analysis.定位: B 段 The region's dry climate and depleted soils would be a recipe for disaster in your average program to replant trees, but for the Amsterdam-based Land Life Company it's an ideal place. 'We typically operate where nature does not come back by itself,' says Jurrian Ruys, its CEO. 'We go where there are rougher conditions in terms of weather, with rough or very hot summers.' 該地區乾燥的氣候和貧瘠的土壤對普通的植樹項目來說會是災難配方，但對總部位於阿姆斯特丹的 Land Life Company 而言卻是理想之地。「我們通常在大自然無法自行恢復的地方作業，」其首席執行官 Jurrian Ruys 說，「我們去氣候條件更惡劣的地方，那裡夏季炎熱或酷暑。」
analysis.改写: Land Life Company's operations↔We typically operate 同義替換 are usually located where reforestation is impossible without human intervention↔where nature does not come back by itself 雙重否定改寫
analysis.辨邻: C 'Does nature return by itself?' asks Arnout Asjes...'Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up' 雖也談 nature return by itself，但沒有說 Land Life 通常在什麼地方作業。 'Does nature return by itself?' asks Arnout Asjes...'Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up'

passages.en: What does self-discipline look like at work? Sometimes, it's the ability to resist temptation, such as distractions to avoid a particular task. Other times it's the ability to persist with a task when your energy and motivation seem low.
passages.zh: 在工作中，自律是什么样的表现？有时，它是抵制诱惑的能力，比如抵制那些让你逃避某项特定任务的干扰。还有些时候，它是在精力和动力似乎都很低的时候，仍然坚持完成一项任务的能力。

passages.en: What do you believe about the nature of your own self-discipline? Is it something that runs on internal energy that is spent with use? Or is it something that is bolstered as you apply it and persist?
passages.zh: 你如何看待自身自律的本质？它是否依靠一种会随着使用而消耗的内在能量运行？还是说，它会在你运用自律并坚持下去的过程中得到增强？

passages.en: Your answer matters, as it determines how much self-discipline you experience. For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is depleted with use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep. More recently, however, research points to the importance of mindset. If you view self-discipline as an expendable resource, your willpower tends to fade with use. If you believe that exercising your self-control strengthens and fuels it, that is more likely to be your experience as you resist temptation or push yourself to get something done that is not appealing.
passages.zh: 你的答案很重要，因为它决定了你能体验到多少自律。多年来，心理学研究认为，自我控制是一种会因使用而消耗、需要通过休息、放松或睡眠来恢复的资源。然而，近来的研究更加重视思维方式的重要性。如果你把自律看作一种会耗尽的资源，你的意志力往往会随着使用而减弱。如果你相信运用自我控制能够增强并补充它，那么当你抵制诱惑，或迫使自己完成一件并不吸引人的事情时，你更有可能获得这样的体验。

passages.en: If you don't already view self-discipline as a force that feeds itself, what might you do? Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible. When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself of those previous experiences and imagine the same happening now.
passages.zh: 如果你还没有把自律看作一种能够自我补充的力量，可以做些什么呢？回想一下这样的时刻：起初你很难抵制诱惑、开始做某件事，或者坚持做下去，但后来你还是继续努力，完成了任务或实现了目标。这正是我们所说的关于自律的这种特定信念所对应的经历，而你已经有过这样的经历，所以你已经证明了这是可能的。当你感到意志力和动力逐渐消退时，提醒自己想起以往的这些经历，并想象现在也会发生同样的情况。

passages.en: What if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control diminishes with use, and you need breaks to recharge? There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take those breaks. If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.
passages.zh: 如果你的经历一直表明，你的自我控制会随着使用而减弱，需要通过休息来充电，那该怎么办？只要你有条件休息，这本身没有什么问题。如果没有条件，那么就提醒自己，并非每个人都会把自律体验为一种会耗尽的资源；如果此时你把注意力放在积蓄更多能量上，而不是关注继续下去有多么困难或认为自己需要休息，你的体验可能会有所不同。

passages.en: Also, if you know someone who is a role model of self-discipline, picture that person in your situation, persisting in the task. Regardless of how you do it, as you push forward to continue to accomplish progress, be sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to exert more willpower as you persist.
passages.zh: 此外，如果你认识一位自律方面的榜样，可以想象那个人处在你的情境中，坚持完成这项任务。无论你采用什么方式，当你继续向前、不断取得进展时，一定要通过为自己能够在坚持过程中发挥出更强的意志力而感到自豪，在心理上不断强化自己。

passages.en: The benefits of exerting willpower are cumulative. Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future.
passages.zh: 发挥意志力所带来的益处会不断累积。你的自律就像一块肌肉，每当你抵制诱惑，或在缺乏动力的情况下仍坚持完成一项任务时，你都会锻炼并强化这块肌肉，从而使自己在今后遇到类似情况时付出更少的努力，也能减少阻力。

option_analysis.note: 抵抗诱惑是self-discipline的一种表现形式，而不是决定人们体验到多少自律的因素。

questions.stem: What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?
questions.stem_zh: 多年的研究表明，自律具有什么特点？

options.text: It is a depletable resource.
options.zh: 它是一种可以耗竭的资源。

options.text: It is bolstered through use.
options.zh: 它会通过使用得到增强。

options.text: Its strength is dependent on willpower.
options.zh: 它的强度取决于意志力。

options.text: Its exercise is an exhausting experience.
options.zh: 运用它是一种令人精疲力竭的经历。

questions.判型: What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?直接询问过去研究的观点，属于事实细节题。
questions.拆句: What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?是特殊疑问句，主语为years of research，谓语为suggest，about self-discipline为介词短语。无复杂从句或否定结构。
questions.定位: P3 For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is depleted with use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep. 多年来，心理学研究把self-control视为一种会随使用而耗尽、需要通过休息、睡眠来恢复的资源。

locate.en: For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is depleted with use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep.
locate.zh: 多年来，心理学研究把self-control视为一种会随使用而耗尽、需要通过休息、睡眠来恢复的资源。

option_analysis.note: It is a depletable resource准确对应a resource that is depleted with use。

pairs.orig: a resource that is depleted with use

option_analysis.note: 这是较新研究/积极信念的观点，不是'years of research'早期研究的结论。
原文并未说self-control的强度dependent on willpower，二者在这里几乎是同义循环。
原文说需要休息恢复，不等于说使用体验是'exhausting experience'（令人筋疲力尽的经历）。

questions.stem: Why does the author ask us to reflect on our experience of meeting the goal despite initial difficulty?
questions.stem_zh: 尽管一开始困难重重却最终实现目标，作者为什么要求我们回想这样的经历？

options.text: To show the urgency of abandoning outdated beliefs about self-control.
options.zh: 说明摒弃关于自我控制的过时观念的紧迫性。

options.text: To show the feasibility of viewing self-discipline as a force fueling itself.
options.zh: 说明将自律视为一种能够自我提供动力的力量是可行的。

options.text: To support the argument for persistence in workplace accomplishments.
options.zh: 支持在工作成就方面坚持不懈的观点。

options.text: To add evidence to consistent findings in previous psychological research.
options.zh: 为以往心理学研究中的一致发现增添证据。

questions.判型: Why does the author ask us to reflect on...虽含why，但仍是就文中具体建议的意图提问，答案可在该建议句附近找到，归为细节题而非推断题。
questions.拆句: Why does the author ask us to reflect on our experience of meeting the goal despite initial difficulty?中，why问目的，主句为the author asks us to reflect on...，of meeting the goal despite initial difficulty为experience的后置定语。无否定或比较结构。
questions.定位: P4 Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible. 回想那些你起初难以抵制诱惑、难以开始或难以坚持，但最终推进并完成任务或达成目标的时刻。这正是我们所说的关于自律的那种特定信念所对应的体验，而且你已经有过这样的体验，所以你已证明这是可能的。

locate.en: Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible.
locate.zh: 回想那些你起初难以抵制诱惑、难以开始或难以坚持，但最终推进并完成任务或达成目标的时刻。这正是我们所说的关于自律的那种特定信念所对应的体验，而且你已经有过这样的体验，所以你已证明这是可能的。

option_analysis.note: 原文并未说要'abandon outdated beliefs'，只是建议补充一种积极信念，没有 urgency 或彻底抛弃旧信念的意思。
viewing self-discipline as a force fueling itself对应this particular belief，the feasibility of对应you've shown that it's possible。

pairs.orig: That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline
pairs.opt: viewing self-discipline as a force fueling itself

option_analysis.note: 虽然文中提到workplace，但本段建议的目的不是支持'职场成就中的坚持'，而是证明自律信念的可行性。
定位句所支持的是'自律可自我强化'的新信念，而非previous psychological research中'self-control会耗尽'的一致发现。

questions.stem: What are we advised to do if we cannot afford to take breaks to recharge?
questions.stem_zh: 如果我们无法抽出时间休息来恢复精力，建议我们怎么做？

options.text: Figure out what has gone wrong.
options.zh: 弄清楚哪里出了问题。

options.text: Focus on the hardest part of our task.
options.zh: 专注于任务中最困难的部分。

options.text: Exert ourselves to go on with the work.
options.zh: 使出全力继续工作。

options.text: Gather new energy from people around.
options.zh: 从身边的人那里汲取新的能量。

questions.判型: What are we advised to do if we cannot afford to take breaks to recharge?询问在特定条件下作者的建议，属于事实细节题。
questions.拆句: What are we advised to do if we cannot afford to take breaks to recharge?中，what作do的宾语，if引导条件状语从句，to recharge为目的状语。整体结构清晰。
questions.定位: P5 If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break. 如果不能休息，提醒自己并非所有人都把自律体验为会耗尽资源；如果你此刻专注于积聚更多能量，而不是专注于继续有多难或需要休息，你的体验可能会不同。

locate.en: If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.
locate.zh: 如果不能休息，提醒自己并非所有人都把自律体验为会耗尽资源；如果你此刻专注于积聚更多能量，而不是专注于继续有多难或需要休息，你的体验可能会不同。

option_analysis.note: 原文并未建议去'figure out what has gone wrong'，而是直接给出调整心态的建议。
原文明确说不要focus on how difficult it is to continue，而该选项说focus on the hardest part，与作者建议相反。
Exert ourselves to go on with the work对应定位句中'focus on gathering more energy...continue'的核心动作。

pairs.orig: focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue
pairs.opt: Exert ourselves to go on with the work

option_analysis.note: 原文说'focus on gathering more energy'，并未说从'people around'那里获取能量；第六段提到role model，但也不是本题条件建议的内容。

questions.stem: Why does the author compare our self-discipline to a muscle?
questions.stem_zh: 作者为什么把我们的自律比作肌肉？

options.text: The more it is applied, the more resistance it encounters.
options.zh: 运用得越多，遇到的阻力就越大。

options.text: The more it is exerted, the more proud we become.
options.zh: 越是运用它，我们就越感到自豪。

options.text: The more it is enforced, the stronger our willpower proves.
options.zh: 越是强行运用它，我们的意志力就越能得到证明。

options.text: The more it is exercised, the more strengthened it gets.
options.zh: 锻炼得越多，它就越强大。

questions.判型: Why does the author compare our self-discipline to a muscle?询问比喻的论证目的，答案在比喻句及其后续解释中可直接找到。
questions.拆句: Why does the author compare our self-discipline to a muscle?中，why问原因/目的，compare...to...是固定搭配，表示把A比作B。无复杂从句。
questions.定位: P7 Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future. 你的自律 akin to 肌肉，每次你抵制诱惑或在缺乏动力时坚持任务，你都在强化那块肌肉，从而在未来类似情况下减少努力和阻力。

locate.en: Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future.
locate.zh: 你的自律 akin to 肌肉，每次你抵制诱惑或在缺乏动力时坚持任务，你都在强化那块肌肉，从而在未来类似情况下减少努力和阻力。

option_analysis.note: 原文说强化肌肉后'leading to less effort and resistance'，即阻力更少，而不是encounters more resistance。
proud是第六段mental reinforce的内容，不是肌肉比喻要说明的要点。
原文说strengthen that muscle（强化自律本身），而选项说stronger our willpower proves，把主语从self-discipline换成了willpower，且语义上二者在此文中近于同义反复。
The more it is exercised, the more strengthened it gets完整对应each time...you strengthen that muscle的解释。

pairs.orig: each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle
pairs.opt: The more it is exercised, the more strengthened it gets

passages.en: Smartphones have always posed challenges for parents of teens. From social media apps to excessive screen time, the digital world is as threatening as the physical.
passages.zh: 智能手机一直给青少年父母带来挑战。从社交媒体应用到过度使用屏幕，数字世界和现实世界一样具有威胁性。

passages.en: A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being exposed to explicit content online. This is a valid concern, of course. But there are ways to alleviate the spread of explicit content, from changing the settings in their kids' phone to monitoring such content with apps like Bark.
passages.zh: 一项新的研究显示，大约一半的青少年父母担心自己的孩子会在网上接触到露骨内容。当然，这种担忧是合理的。但是，有一些方法可以减缓露骨内容的传播，比如更改孩子手机中的设置，或使用 Bark 等应用监控这类内容。

passages.en: Just as alarming, if not more so, is that the amount of time teens spend on social media can lead to anxiety and depression.
passages.zh: 同样令人担忧，甚至更加令人担忧的是，青少年花在社交媒体上的时间可能会导致焦虑和抑郁。

passages.en: Excessive screen time has detrimental effects, for a lot of obvious reasons. Constant media consumption inhibits healthy activities associated with childhood, like spending time outside, exercising, talking to friends and family. If it interferes with sleep, that's even worse.
passages.zh: 过度使用屏幕会产生不利影响，原因有很多，而且显而易见。持续接触媒体会妨碍童年时期与健康相关的活动，例如待在户外、锻炼以及与朋友和家人交谈。如果它还干扰睡眠，那就更糟糕了。

passages.en: Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression, and feelings of isolation in teens. Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever. Faceless communication not only produces feelings of isolation and loneliness but increases instances of online bullying and susceptibility to criminal conducts.
passages.zh: 大量研究表明，过度使用智能手机会使青少年产生严重的焦虑、抑郁和孤立感。青少年登录社交媒体或上网，试图建立联系，但最终却比以往任何时候都感到更加孤独和悲伤。无面对面的交流不仅会产生孤立感和孤独感，还会增加网络欺凌事件以及受犯罪行为影响的可能性。

passages.en: Though I've banned most social media, I've still battled smartphone time with my own kids. A lot of the time I wish I could throw my kids' smartphones into the nearest lake. The convenience of communication—when they need a ride home from school after practice, for instance—often feels like it isn't worth the battle to keep their screen time low and productive, and continue to encourage "real-life" activities outside and with friends and family. I understand the addiction and often tell them I'm not sure how I would have handled having a smartphone as a teen. As an adult, I too, struggle with overuse.
passages.zh: 虽然我已经禁止使用大多数社交媒体，但我仍然一直在和自己的孩子争论使用智能手机的时间。很多时候，我真希望能把孩子们的智能手机扔进最近的湖里。通信的便利性——比如他们课外活动结束后需要搭车回家时——常常让人觉得，为了控制他们的屏幕使用时间，使其保持较低水平并发挥积极作用，同时继续鼓励他们在户外以及与朋友和家人进行“现实生活”活动，并不值得这样争斗。我理解这种成瘾，而且常常告诉他们，我不知道自己在青少年时期拥有一部智能手机会如何应对。作为一个成年人，我也在努力应对过度使用的问题。

passages.en: In a recent TV interview to promote a new film about a mother and daughter navigating social media use, actress Kate Winslet expressed her view on teens and social media—and her concern mirrors the trends. "I do definitely feel that the world of social media is frightening to parents because we don't really know what's there," she said. "We don't know how our children are using it. We don't know the effects that it's really having on them."
passages.zh: 在最近一次为宣传一部讲述母女共同应对社交媒体使用问题的新电影而进行的电视采访中，女演员凯特·温斯莱特表达了她对青少年和社交媒体的看法，而她的担忧与相关趋势相一致。她说：“我确实觉得，社交媒体的世界令父母感到害怕，因为我们并不真正知道那里有什么。我们不知道自己的孩子是如何使用它的。我们不知道它究竟会对他们产生什么影响。”

passages.en: I don't think the U.S. government should regulate social media and teen smartphone use, but it is a vital topic for parents to understand and take seriously. Unfortunately, now, parents don't just have to worry about real-world dangers, but all the ones sneaking online and the effects they have on teenagers and their mental health.
passages.zh: 我认为美国政府不应监管社交媒体和青少年使用智能手机的问题，但这是一个父母必须了解并认真对待的重要话题。遗憾的是，如今父母不仅要担心现实世界中的危险，还要担心所有悄悄潜入网络的危险，以及这些危险对青少年及其心理健康造成的影响。

questions.stem: What do around half of parents of teens do according to a new study?
questions.stem_zh: 根据一项新研究，大约一半有青少年的父母会做什么？

options.text: They set their kids' phones to filter out obscene information.
options.zh: 他们将孩子的手机设置为过滤淫秽信息。

options.text: They try to alleviate the spread of explicit scenes on the internet.
options.zh: 他们试图减缓互联网上露骨场景的传播。

options.text: They feel concerned about their kids' viewing indecent content online.
options.zh: 他们担心孩子在网上观看不雅内容。

options.text: They strive to prevent their kids from spending excessive screen time.
options.zh: 他们努力防止孩子花费过多时间看屏幕。

questions.判型: 题干What do around half of parents of teens do according to a new study?询问研究中的具体事实，属于对单一信息的直接考查。
questions.拆句: 主干为What do...parents do，according to a new study为介词短语作状语，说明信息来源。整体是简单疑问句，无否定、比较等陷阱。
questions.定位: P2 A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being exposed to explicit content online. 一项新研究显示，约半数青少年父母担心自己的孩子在网上接触露骨内容。

locate.en: A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being exposed to explicit content online.
locate.zh: 一项新研究显示，约半数青少年父母担心自己的孩子在网上接触露骨内容。

option_analysis.flag: 偷换概念：措施≠已实施行为
option_analysis.note: A项They set their kids' phones to filter out obscene information.把第二段中changing the settings这类可能的缓解措施，说成是父母已经采取的行动，而原文并未说半数父母已这样做。

option_analysis.flag: 偷换概念：可能性≠实际行为
option_analysis.note: B项They try to alleviate the spread of explicit scenes on the internet.把原文there are ways to alleviate the spread（存在缓解途径）替换为父母try to alleviate（正在尝试缓解），改变了行为主体与事实状态。
C项They feel concerned about their kids' viewing indecent content online.准确对应定位句中父母worried about孩子being exposed to explicit content online。

pairs.orig: being exposed to explicit content online

option_analysis.flag: 答非所问：跨段混用话题
option_analysis.note: D项They strive to prevent their kids from spending excessive screen time.将第三段以后才出现的excessive screen time话题嫁接到第二段关于explicit content的研究结论上，答非所问。

questions.stem: What does a large amount of research show about teens' excessive smartphone use?
questions.stem_zh: 大量研究显示，青少年过度使用智能手机会造成什么影响？

options.text: It allows them less time for meaningful activities.
options.zh: 这使他们用于有意义活动的时间减少。

options.text: It renders them more lonely and low-spirited.
options.zh: 这使他们更加孤独和情绪低落。

options.text: It gives them less time for social interactions.
options.zh: 这使他们用于社交活动的时间减少。

options.text: It makes them more alert to online bullying.
options.zh: 这使他们更加警觉网络欺凌。

questions.判型: 题干What does a large amount of research show about teens' excessive smartphone use?要求找出研究所示的具体结果。
questions.拆句: 主干为What...research show，about teens' excessive smartphone use为介词短语限定范围。无复杂从句或否定。
questions.定位: P5 Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression, and feelings of isolation in teens. Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever. 大量研究表明，过度使用智能手机会给青少年带来严重的焦虑、抑郁和孤独感。青少年登录社交媒体或上网试图建立联系，但最终感到比以往更加孤独和悲伤。

locate.en: Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression, and feelings of isolation in teens. Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever.
locate.zh: 大量研究表明，过度使用智能手机会给青少年带来严重的焦虑、抑郁和孤独感。青少年登录社交媒体或上网试图建立联系，但最终感到比以往更加孤独和悲伤。

option_analysis.flag: 偷换概念：上位/下位词替换失当
option_analysis.note: A项It allows them less time for meaningful activities.把第四段healthy activities associated with childhood, like spending time outside, exercising, talking to friends and family中的healthy activities替换为meaningful activities，缩小并改变了概念范围。
B项It renders them more lonely and low-spirited.准确概括了定位句中more alone and sad than ever及feelings of isolation的含义。

option_analysis.flag: 与原文相反：行为方向矛盾
option_analysis.note: C项It gives them less time for social interactions.说减少了社交时间，但原文Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections说明青少年反而花更多时间在网上进行社交尝试。

option_analysis.flag: 偷换概念：结果→主体态度
option_analysis.note: D项It makes them more alert to online bullying.把原文increases instances of online bullying（增加网络欺凌案例）改为more alert to online bullying（对网络欺凌更警觉），改变了语义关系。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the author's feelings regarding smartphones and screen time?
questions.stem_zh: 我们从作者对智能手机和屏幕使用时间的看法中了解到什么？

options.text: They are deep-seated.
options.zh: 这种看法根深蒂固。

options.text: They are instinctive.
options.zh: 这种看法出于本能。

options.text: They are unique.
options.zh: 这种看法与众不同。

options.text: They are mixed.
options.zh: 这种看法很复杂，兼具正反两面。

questions.判型: 题干What do we learn about the author's feelings regarding smartphones and screen time?直接询问作者对某事物的情感态度。
questions.拆句: 主干为What do we learn about the author's feelings，regarding smartphones and screen time为介词短语说明对象。无复杂结构。

option_analysis.flag: 以偏概全：只取单一态度信号
option_analysis.note: A项They are deep-seated.（根深蒂固的）只呼应了作者对智能手机问题的强烈反感，但忽略了作者承认便利和理解上瘾的部分。

option_analysis.flag: 偷换概念：情感强烈≠本能
option_analysis.note: B项They are instinctive.（本能的）将作者对智能手机的厌恶理解为本能反应，但原文明确给出了理性原因（屏幕时间、通讯便利等），并非单纯本能。
C项They are unique.（独特的）在原文中没有任何对应信息，作者反而说I understand the addiction，暗示这种感受具有普遍性。
D项They are mixed.用一词概括了第六段中作者既反感又理解、既看到弊端又承认便利的复杂情感。

translation.title: 2026年6月·第2套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 中国农村电商发展现状介绍 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌。随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸， 越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费者。近年来，直播带货 ( live- streaming commerce) 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。
translation.reference_en:
The booming development of e-commerce is profoundly changing the face of rural China. As the Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas, more and more rural residents are selling their agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms. In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which enables urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time, has become a new way to promote rural development. E-commerce has broken down the information barriers between urban and rural areas and expanded sales channels for agricultural products, helping rural residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity. The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization is injecting unprecedented vitality into China's rural development.
【衔接】
句2→句3：用时间线自然衔接句2讲「随着……延伸」的背景趋势，句3以近年来推进到最新现象，英文保留 In recent years 置于句首，两句之间形成「背景→新进展」的时间递进，无需额外关联词，靠时间状语即完成衔接。
句4主语重复「电子商务」的处理电子商务在句1、句4两次作主语，因中间隔了两句、指代链已断，句4不宜用代词 it（会让读者回头找错对象），直接重复 E-commerce 反而清楚；句4内部用 helping 分词承接结果，避免 and 三连。
句5收束：与句1进行时首尾呼应句1「正在深刻改变」与句5「正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力」都用现在进行时（is changing / is injecting），一开头一收尾形成闭环，末句无需加 In short 之类总结词，时态一致本身就是连贯信号。

cohesion.detail: 句2讲「随着……延伸」的背景趋势，句3以近年来推进到最新现象，英文保留 In recent years 置于句首，两句之间形成「背景→新进展」的时间递进，无需额外关联词，靠时间状语即完成衔接。

cohesion.core: 句4主语重复「电子商务」的处理
cohesion.detail: 电子商务在句1、句4两次作主语，因中间隔了两句、指代链已断，句4不宜用代词 it（会让读者回头找错对象），直接重复 E-commerce 反而清楚；句4内部用 helping 分词承接结果，避免 and 三连。

cohesion.core: 句5收束：与句1进行时首尾呼应
cohesion.detail: 句1「正在深刻改变」与句5「正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力」都用现在进行时（is changing / is injecting），一开头一收尾形成闭环，末句无需加 In short 之类总结词，时态一致本身就是连贯信号。

main_idea.core: 中国农村电商发展现状介绍
main_idea.detail: 整段围绕电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌展开，逐句铺陈电商进农村、直播带货、城乡信息壁垒被打破、数字经济与乡村振兴融合等事实。这是典型的六级汉译英语体：对中国社会经济发展成就的客观介绍，属说明性语体，用词应正式、平实，不抒情、不口语。

tense.detail: 全段是在陈述当下正在发生的客观趋势：正在深刻改变、正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力用的是进行体，打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒、已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式是已完成的结果。以一般现在时为默认骨架，凡带「正在」的句子用现在进行时、带「了/已成为/近年来」的句子用现在完成时，这三者同属「现在」时间域，基调统一、不算飘忽。

term_notes.detail: 统一译作 e-commerce（全篇词根一致，动词义用 e-commerce platforms 表「电子商务平台」）。电子商务在句1与句4两次出现，必须前后同一译法，切忌一处 e-commerce、一处 electronic commerce 混用。
原文已随文给出注释，直接采用 live-streaming commerce（直播带货），不要再自造 live selling 等说法；给定注释就用给定译名是六级汉译英的送分纪律。
统一译作 agricultural products。农产品在句2、句4出现两次，全篇只用这一个译法，不与 farm produce 混用。
译作 rural revitalization（约定俗成的官方译名，乡村振兴），与「中国农村」的 rural China、「农村发展」的 rural development 保持 rural 一词贯通。
译作 the digital economy（数字经济），economy 此处作特指概念用定冠词 the。

steps.text: 发展正在改变面貌（主语策略：原句主语）中文核心动词是改变，做这动作的是电子商务的蓬勃发展，承受对象是「中国农村的面貌」。英文主干立为 The development is changing the face：主语 The booming development of e-commerce，谓语 is changing（进行时呼应「正在」），宾语 the face of rural China。
两个「的」字修饰后置主干之外的修饰全是「的」字结构：电子商务的作「发展」的定语→后置介词短语 of e-commerce；「中国农村的」作「面貌」的定语→后置 of rural China；「蓬勃」「深刻」分别译作形容词 booming 与副词 profoundly，直接贴在被修饰词旁。全句无需从句，把定语从名词前搬到名词后即可。

时态「正在改变」用现在进行时 is changing——它属于全篇「现在」时间域，与基调一致，是基允许内的偏离，不要写成一般现在时 changes（丢了「正在」的进行义）。 单复数与冠词development 表抽象「发展」不可数，用单数不加复数；face 此处特指中国农村的面貌，用 the face。rural China 是固定表达，China 前不加 the。 主谓一致主语中心词是 development（单数），谓语用 is changing，不要被紧随其后的 of e-commerce 带偏。
The booming development of e-commerce is profoundly changing the face of rural China.

居民销售农产品（主语策略：原句主语）逗号后的主句才是全句重心：越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费者。核心动词「销售」→sell；主语「农村居民」→rural residents；宾语「农产品」→agricultural products；「城市消费者」是间接对象→to urban consumers。主干：rural residents sell agricultural products to urban consumers。

「随着」降为背景状语从句随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸是全句背景→降级为 As 引导的时间/背景状语从句 As the Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas；通过电子商务平台表方式→介词短语 through e-commerce platforms 作状语；「直接」→副词 directly 修饰 sell。主干之外三块各有归处，不用 and 平铺。

单复数「居民」「消费者」都是泛指的一类人，用复数 rural residents、urban consumers；logistics networks 与 e-commerce platforms 同为泛指复数；Internet 表「互联网」惯用 the Internet。 时态主句可理解为主正在发生的趋势，用现在进行时 are selling 呼应全篇「现在」域；As 从句表伴随背景，用一般现在时 extend 即可。 搭配「把某物卖给某人」用 sell sth. to sb.，to 不可省；「延伸到农村」用 extend into rural areas，into 表进入方向。
As the Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas, more and more rural residents are selling their agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms.
直播带货已成为新方式（主语策略：原句主语）本句一个主语带两个动作：使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动与已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。判断语义重心在后者（下结论），故主干取 live-streaming commerce has become a new way：主语沿用原文给定译名 live-streaming commerce，谓语 has become，表语 a new way。

「使……」降级为定语从句使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动降级为 which 引导的非限定定语从句 which enables urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time，插回主语之后；「促进农村发展的」修饰 way→后置不定式 to promote rural development；近年来→句首时间状语 In recent years。

时态近年来＋「已成为」是现在完成时的双重标志，谓语用 has become；这是对基调的合理偏离，不能用一般现在时 becomes（丢了「至今已成」的完成义）。 主谓一致主语 live-streaming commerce 是单数概念，谓语用 has become；定语从句内 which 指代它，从句谓语用 enables。 搭配「与某人实时互动」interact with sb. in real time，in real time 是固定搭配无冠词；「一种新方式」a new way to do sth.，way 后接不定式。
In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which enables urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time, has become a new way to promote rural development.
电商打破壁垒、拓宽渠道（主语策略：原句主语）主语电子商务带三个动作：打破、拓宽、帮助。前两个「打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒」「拓宽了农产品销售渠道」是并列的核心成果，可作共用同一主语的并列谓语 has broken down ... and expanded ...；「帮助……」是这两个成果带来的结果，留给下一步降级。

结果动作降为分词帮助农村居民增收致富是前两动作带来的结果→现在分词短语 helping rural residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity 作结果状语；「城乡之间的」修饰壁垒→between urban and rural areas 后置；「农产品销售渠道」→sales channels for agricultural products，渠道用 for 短语后置修饰。四字格「增收致富」拆开意译为 increase their incomes and achieve prosperity。

时态两个「了」均表已完成且影响延续至今，用现在完成时 has broken down ... and expanded ...，共用一个 has；分词 helping 无时态问题。 单复数barriers 与 channels 均为泛指复数；incomes 指众居民各自的收入，用复数。 搭配「打破壁垒」break down the barriers 为惯用搭配；「城乡之间」between urban and rural areas；「增收」increase one's incomes，one's 与 rural residents 对应为 their。

E-commerce has broken down the information barriers between urban and rural areas and expanded sales channels for agricultural products, helping rural residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity.

融合正在注入活力（主语策略：原句主语）核心动词注入→is injecting；发出动作的主语是「数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合」这个整体名词短语→The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization；宾语「活力」→vitality；「为中国农村发展」表受益方向→into China's rural development。主干：The deep integration is injecting vitality into China's rural development。

本就是单主干句，修饰后置即可本句中文本身只有一个谓语「注入」，无需降级从句：「数字经济与乡村振兴的」→后置 of the digital economy with rural revitalization；「深度」→形容词 deep 前置修饰 integration；「前所未有的」→unprecedented 前置修饰 vitality；「为中国农村发展」→介词短语 into China's rural development 表注入方向。

时态「正在注入」用现在进行时 is injecting，与句1「正在改变」首尾呼应，同属全篇「现在」域。 单复数integration、vitality 均为抽象不可数名词，用单数、不加复数；主语中心词 integration 是单数，谓语用 is。 搭配「为……注入活力」inject vitality into ... 为固定搭配，into 不可换成 to；「A与B的融合」the integration of A with B。
The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization is injecting unprecedented vitality into China's rural development.
